description.zh: 让助手使用 monid 提供的上千个外部工具（搜索、网页抓取、语音合成、视频生成等）
description.en: Let the assistant use thousands of external tools from monid (search, scraping, speech, video and more)

cost.zh: monid 是第三方服务：使用前在 monid 预存余额，每次调用按该工具的价格扣费（有的按次，有的按返回条数），以 monid 账单为准。积微对它的每个工具都会先问你再调用。
cost.en: monid is a third-party service: you prepay a balance and each call is charged at that tool's price (per call or per result), as shown on your monid bill. Jiwei asks you before every monid tool call.
